content: Hi, before the shop walkthrough could you check in with Quayline Coatings? They do our powder coating and I want to confirm turnaround. Thanks!
Also the ultrasonic cleaner in the back is showing an error, it's a Soniclear S-300 for the manual lookup. Can you also track our freight booking under BK-5391-QT?
One more thing, the packaging audit is on 14 August so we should prepare. Aldric Venn just started helping coordinate logistics for us, please include him in updates.
Morning, could you check if Tremorlab Q-36 is free this afternoon? We need the chamber for vibration testing. Also pull up directions to Keldorvik Harbor, that's where the supplier demo is tomorrow.
A bit long, thanks — just the project name is enough next time.
Quick favor between builds, can you log TW-118-ZK as the code for those prototype fasteners? And remind Bodil Kranz she still has the checkout sheet, she looks after the tool crib.
Before lunch, could you call Voltmere Installations? They put in our backup generator and the panel is showing a fault.
Can you remind me what the conference city is?
heads up, our laser cutter location is now ground floor workshop
Could you email our contact at the client about my purchase-order approval limit?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks!
change of plan: fire assembly point is now south lot entrance
heads up, our safety officer is now Mira Solberg
Could you remind me who our carbon-fibre supplier is?
Can you remind me what my job title is?
Perfect, thanks — short and direct, just how I like updates.
